lines.text: Paul tells the commander he is a Jew from Tarsus, then addresses the crowd in Hebrew.
Paul says he was educated at the feet of Nicodemus and persecuted this Way even to the death.
Near Damascus at noon, a bright light flashes, Jesus of Nazareth speaks to Paul, and companions lead him in.
While Paul prays at the temple, the Lord tells him to leave Jerusalem and sends him to the Egyptians.
Paul asks the centurion if it is lawful to flog a Roman citizen, and the commander is alarmed.
